result.topic_en: Riemann considers the special case of the rotating fluid ellipsoid in which one pair of quantities (u, u', v, v', w, w') stays permanently zero, so that a principal axis keeps a fixed direction and the instantaneous rotation axis coincides with it, and he derives constants of motion and reciprocity relations.

methods.what: Special case of the ellipsoid motion: one pair of variables vanishes identically, so the instantaneous rotation axis is perpendicular to a principal axis lying in the invariable plane
In this case the following combinations are constants of motion (from the differential equations (α))
Proportionality (reciprocity) relations between the constants g, h, k and the quantities p, q, r
An integral formula for a quantity K, written in isolation at the foot of the page
